scope: Bounded real budget comparison on the frozen v41 acquired materials; Agent natural final-answer/review path, not a fresh retrieval test or full Q02 A/B.
questions: Unchanged v41 T3 and T4. Both arms start T3 with the same actual published v41 T1/T2 prefix, including its old Runtime fallback. Each T4 uses its own newly published T3 answer.
t3_input: Complete phase-closed request captured at the offline boundary. Rebuild projection from the identical full authoritative prior packet under each allowance; protect every actual v41 T3 tool result.
failure_handling: No hidden retry or replacement. A failed T3 leaves that arm's T4 unexecuted; retain the failed attempt and unknown native usage. Independent second arm may proceed.
acceptance: Record full sent and unsent payloads, whole omitted source/history items, all native usage fields and latency; primary review every complete reply against exact bodies, qualifiers and own history. A larger budget reaching the endpoint is only a tested lower bound, not the advertised context ceiling or a quality gain.
